market_view: VIX calm at 15.7 but yields at a 252-day high (10-year 5.16%) with a firm dollar; oil volatile (WTI -7% in 5 days, +2.7% on the day), chips rebounding. Headlines are again noise with no named catalyst on a leader.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI and Brent swings are driver moves already in the price; XOM moved only +0.6%. Only the Shell buyback notice appears, which is routine. No OPEC+, Hormuz or XOM headline.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold -7.6% in 20 days against record-high yields and a firm dollar; no relief signal. KGC -11.6% in one day has no headline in the record. No NEM headline.

chips.reasoning: Motley Fool 'AMD Just Joined Nvidia in the $1 Trillion Club' is commentary, and the Vicor guidance raise concerns a different company. No NVDA guidance or export-rule headline; rebound already priced in.

pharma.reasoning: Motley Fool 'Viking Therapeutics Soared After Its Latest GLP-1 Data' is a competitor read-across, not a positive for LLY. No LLY trial, regulator or pricing headline.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper is near its high and already priced in; uranium is weak. The ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih item is steel in Ukraine and not a copper supply shock. No FCX or China-data headline.

would_change_my_mind: A named headline on XOM, NEM, NVDA, LLY or FCX: OPEC+ or Hormuz supply news, NVDA guidance or export-rule change, an LLY trial, approval or pricing item, a copper mine outage or China demand data.

handoff.what_changed: Three days since the 09-22 note. WTI rose 2.7% on 09-24 but is -7% over 5 days; the 10-year yield hit a new high of 5.16% and gold fell to -7.6% in 20 days. AMD hit a $1T market cap; headlines again had no named catalyst, so all five families stay flat.

chips.why: Rebound priced in; no NVDA guidance or export-rule headline.
